topic: 限时写作：原因、办法与双边讨论
grammarFocus: 因果关系、条件和对比；段落间逻辑与指代。
title: Timed Writing: Causes, Solutions and Two-Sided Discussion
prompt: In many countries, people now spend a large part of their working lives in jobs that require them to be available by phone or email outside normal office hours. Some people believe this constant connection improves productivity and career prospects, while others argue that it seriously harms employees' well-being and family life. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your answer, you should explain why this situation has become common, propose at least one practical measure that employers or governments could take to reduce its negative effects, and state clearly which view you support overall. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为限时写作练习（建议40分钟）。请先花约5分钟审题并列出双方观点、原因和至少一条解决办法，再用约30分钟完成全文，最后留约5分钟检查。注意：题目要求你讨论双方观点、说明这一现象普遍的原因、提出至少一项可行措施，并明确表达自己的总体立场，四个要素缺一不可。请使用自己的例子或一般性推理，不要编造具体统计数据或引用官方报告。本材料中的所有情景与数据均为模拟练习内容，并非官方雅思试卷。
